properties.name: Visibility 1
properties.description: Select or clear to display or hide this specific information element.

properties.name: Visualization 1
properties.description: Visualization type of this information element. A datastream value can be presented just on its own, as a single value. Alternatively a progress bar can be added.

properties.name: Label 1
properties.description: Label text of this information element.

properties.name: Datastream 1
properties.description: Choose from available datastreams in the dropdown after a simulation was connected or type the exact name of the datastream as defined in the model that provides the data during the simulation for this information element.

properties.name: Unit 1
properties.description: The unit text or symbol that is displayed next to the value.

properties.name: Float precision 1
properties.description: The amount of decimal places shown for the data stream value. Only affects display, not calculations.

properties.name: Minimum value 1
properties.description: The minimum value for the progress bar. Only shows if visualization type is 'Progress bar'.

properties.description: The maximum value for the progress bar. Only shows if visualization type is 'Progress bar'.
